source.description: One reviewed eight-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into seven cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one mischievous raccoon peeking from one open ribbed trash can with exactly two ears, two eyes, two gripping paws, one crooked grin with one small tooth, one ringed tail with exactly three dark bands, two can handles, four vertical can ribs, one diamond-shaped dent, two mustard accent blocks, one tall paper highlight, and one broken shadow.

process_strategy: Use eight cumulative stages so the complete pale construction, rough silhouette, refined overlaps, facial and tail markings, expression and can details, black ink, marker color, and final reinforcement each receive a distinct visible job. Reserve the head, paws, and tail before drawing the can rim and ribs so no keeper line is erased later.

final_elements.description: A doubled can rim and bottom band, exactly two side handles, three vertical ribs, a rounded raccoon muzzle, two clear gripping paws, and one thick tail contour.

final_elements.description: Two asymmetrical mask patches, two eye openings, one raised-brow guide, one dark nose, one crooked grin with one small tooth, and exactly three band guides across the tail.

final_elements.description: One half-lidded eye and one wider eye with both pupils glancing to page right, one raised brow, cheek tufts, one diamond-shaped dent, two small accent blocks, one tall open-paper highlight, and one broken shadow.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip keeper lines and restrained fur and metal hatching
final_elements.description: Imperfect black felt-tip traces every established animal, can, expression, marking, highlight, accent, and shadow boundary with short fur and metal hatching.

final_elements.description: Cool gray raccoon fur, charcoal masks and three tail bands, teal can panels, coral ear interiors, two mustard accent blocks, and a deep-navy broken shadow around one tall paper highlight.

rejection_checks: Keep one raccoon, one open trash can, one peeking pose, one crop, and one scale in all eight panels.

Keep two ears, two eyes, two paws, one small tooth, one tail with three dark bands, two can handles, four ribs, one diamond dent, two mustard accent blocks, one tall paper highlight, and one shadow after those elements appear.
Both pupils must look toward page right from step 5 onward; one eye stays half-lidded, the other wider, and one brow stays raised.
The back rim must stop behind the head, the front rim must stop at both paws, and can ribs must stop at the tail and bottom band; no keeper line may be erased to fake an overlap.
Do not add a lid, garbage pile, food, alley scenery, second animal, extra limb, extra tail, words, letters, logo, sticker border, badge frame, label, arrow, signature, or watermark.
The final panel may not introduce an ear, paw, facial feature, tooth, tail band, handle, rib, dent, accent, highlight, hatch cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean clip art, polished character rendering, or glossy AI poster art.
